# Gislind Ursin

> **Hollow Eye** des Neuf Yeux — tutrice **Culture + Philosophy** de Wolfgang. Originaire **Averheim**. Cultiste Tzeentch active. **Left Reikguard several weeks ago for Altdorf**. Room canon : **playwrights folios + Strange Flower play von Deihl** = *« someone interested in von Deihl's work may sympathise with Mutants »* — hint Edit Mutants influence.

A copy of von Deihl's Strange Flower is left open by the bed. With a Difficult (-10) Intuition Test, a Character may glean that someone interested in von Deihl's work may sympathise with Mutants »*.
